illustrations.position_quote: Section 11 of RA 6713 specifies penalties and administrative consequences for violations of the Code of Conduct.
illustrations.description: A compact flow diagram that branches Section 11 into general administrative sanctions, Sections 7/8/9 criminal penalties, private-conspirator liability, prohibited statement-use penalties, and the heavier-law and no-criminal-case conditions.
illustrations.why: The learning goal asks students to match violation categories to consequences and distinguish administrative action from criminal prosecution; seeing the consequence paths side by side would make those distinctions easier to compare.
